title: EReCu: Pseudo-label Evolution Fusion and Refinement with Multi-Cue Learning for Unsupervised Camouflage Detection
abstract: arXiv:2603.11521v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Unsupervised Camouflaged Object Detection (UCOD) remains a challenging task due to the high intrinsic similarity between target objects and their surroundings, as well as the reliance on noisy pseudo-labels that hinder fine-grained texture learning. While existing refinement strategies aim to alleviate label noise, they often overlook intrinsic perceptual cues, leading to boundary overflow and structural ambiguity. In contrast, learning without pseudo-label guidance yields coarse features with significant detail loss. To address these issues, we propose a unified UCOD framework that enhances both the reliability of pseudo-labels and the fidelity of features. Our approach introduces the Multi-Cue Native Perception module, which extracts intrinsic visual priors by integrating low-level texture cues with mid-level semantics, enabling precise alignment between masks and native object information. translated_title: EReCu：面向无监督伪装检测的伪标签演化融合与精炼及多线索学习方法
translated_abstract: 无监督伪装目标检测（UCOD）仍然是一项具有挑战性的任务，原因在于目标物体与其周围环境之间存在高度的内在相似性，以及对含噪伪标签的依赖，这些伪标签阻碍了细粒度纹理的学习。现有的精炼策略旨在缓解标签噪声，但往往忽视内在感知线索，导致边界溢出和结构模糊。相比之下，没有伪标签指导的学习会产生粗糙的特征，并伴随显著的细节损失。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一个统一的UCOD框架，同时提升伪标签的可靠性和特征的保真度。我们的方法引入了多线索原生感知模块，通过将低层纹理线索与中层语义相结合来提取内在视觉先验，从而实现掩码与原生物体信息之间的精确对齐。此外，该框架还包含伪标签演化融合与精炼机制，用于逐步提升伪标签质量。（注：原文摘要不完整，以上为已提供部分的翻译）
tldr: 该论文提出了统一的无监督伪装检测框架EReCu，通过多线索原生感知模块提取内在视觉先验，并结合伪标签演化融合与精炼策略，同时提升伪标签的可靠性和特征的保真度，解决了边界溢出与结构模糊问题。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes EReCu, a unified framework for unsupervised camouflaged object detection that enhances both pseudo-label reliability and feature fidelity by integrating a Multi-Cue Native Perception module with pseudo-label evolution fusion and refinement.
